checks: Independent practice attempts start with no task credit or SVI addresses; VLANs, Layer 2 ports, trunk and hosts are preconfigured
Published supported IOS commands create and save the three DSW1 gateway SVIs, global routing, SW1 management SVI and management default gateway
Operational task checks actual interface state for all four SVIs and real connected /24 routes on DSW1
Four packet checks validate local management, inter-VLAN traffic in both directions and SW1-originated traffic through its gateway; completed reference requires fresh replies
Disabling DSW1 IP routing preserves local gateway and management access but stops transit forwarding; restoring routing repairs user traffic
Removing or misconfiguring SW1 default gateway stops its remote traffic while local management and user routing continue; restoring it repairs the remote management check
Shutting the only DSW1 trunk member withdraws all three connected VLAN routes and drops SVI line protocol despite enabled addressed SVIs; SW1 Vlan99 remains up through ADMIN1
Pruning a VLAN, suspending it or shutting its SVI withdraws that gateway; corrective settings recover actual packets
SVI configuration goals require correct IP, exact mask and no shutdown; physical switchports retain Layer 2 operation and no IP addressing
Observed real routing receives VLAN 10 frames and transmits VLAN 20 frames with one IP TTL decrement
Every reference show/ping command works; portable reload and switch power cycles retain startup settings, stable-ID objectives, operational state and earned echo observations
Imported interface-up criteria are bounded data, reject invalid interface values and cannot pass for missing, unpowered or down interfaces
